discoveries.details: First full development verification passed 434 tests and failed four tests with hardcoded alpha.11 runtime expectations. Expectations now bind alpha.12; no security assertion was relaxed.

Docker Git refused the ownership of /repo, Gitleaks logged 0 commits scanned and emitted an empty report with exit 0. Original validator accepted that array. Validator now requires all immutable reviewed fingerprints; empty, subset and missing-one reports fail. Correctly bound pinned Docker scan traversed 61 commits and found the same 14 reviewed non-secret findings. Counts at that invocation predate later evidence commits.

Pre-existing remote branch identity is absent from frozen publication approval metadata. No identity allowlist, author, commit or ref was modified. A separate HEAD audit passes and does not replace ALL_REFS.
